name: notification-hub.conversation-read
purpose: Read one exact Notification Hub ask using the owner's conversation-scoped GetAsk binding.

ask_id.description: Exact owner-issued ask ID; mutually exclusive with subject_key.

subject_key.description: Exact owner-issued subject key; mutually exclusive with ask_id.

assumptions: Notification Hub is the authority for both exact identity and conversation/owner access; a refused or not-found read stays refused/unavailable.
The ask is returned only to the authorized caller through this program result; do not copy private conversation content into Memory, evidence, logs, or another destination.
invariants: Exactly one non-empty ask_id or subject_key is required; the program never lists or searches asks.
Use only notification-hub/conversations/get and verify the returned ask ID or subject key matches the requested identity.
Return the owner ask to the authorized caller without writing, summarizing, logging, or copying its content elsewhere.
On error, omit owner detail because it may include private conversation data.

signals.ask: The exact owner ask returned to its authorized caller; conversation content is private and not retained by this program outside its run receipt.

outputs.evidence: The single owner GetAsk binding; no ask fields or content are copied into evidence.
